name: Nothing beats a Jet2 holiday
blurb: A cheerful Jet2 ad voiceover plus "Hold My Hand", laid over holiday disasters on TikTok
title: Nothing Beats a Jet2 Holiday: The Meme and Song Explained
description: "Nothing beats a Jet2 holiday" is a TikTok meme that pairs a UK airline ad's upbeat voiceover and Jess Glynne's "Hold My Hand" with clips of chaos and disaster.
h1: What is the "Nothing beats a Jet2 holiday" meme?
answer: "Nothing beats a Jet2 holiday" is the slogan of British airline and holiday company Jet2, voiced in its TV ad by actress Zoë Lister over Jess Glynne's 2015 song "Hold My Hand". On TikTok people use that cheerful audio ironically, laying it over clips of travel disasters, fights, accidents and general chaos. It started spreading in late 2024 and became one of TikTok's biggest sounds in summer 2025.

body: The joke is the clash. The audio promises a perfect, stress-free family holiday: a bright voiceover, the slogan and the swelling chorus of "Hold My Hand". The video shows the opposite: a camel chasing a tourist, a hotel room in ruins, a brawl at the airport, a sunburnt Brit, or anything that goes spectacularly wrong. Often the clip has nothing to do with holidays at all.

body.note: The voice belongs to Zoë Lister, a British actress known for playing Zoe Carpenter in Hollyoaks from 2006 to 2017. She has said she never expected the ad to travel worldwide.

head: Date
Event
rows: Jet2 launches its "Nothing beats a Jet2holiday" ad campaign in the UK.
The TV ad with "Hold My Hand" is uploaded to Jet2's YouTube channel.
The ad goes up on TikTok, where its audio becomes a reusable sound.
A clip of a camel going after a holidaymaker, set to the ad, gets millions of plays and sets the ironic template.
Jet2's own TikTok joins the meme and launches a #Jet2Challenge with holiday-voucher prizes.
The sound peaks; NBC News reports more than 1.2 million TikTok users have used it, and Lister and Glynne meet on Capital FM in London.

ul: Over a cancelled-flight departures board: the slogan, then the chorus.
Under a clip of a pool float flying away in the wind.
For everyday chaos: a toddler emptying a cupboard, captioned "Nothing beats a Jet2 holiday."
In comments: "This needs the Jet2 holiday audio."

body: It was the sound of summer 2025 and is still widely recognised, though it now gets used less often and more as a callback. It belongs to the same family as other ironic TikTok sounds where upbeat audio is paired with disaster. For Jet2 it worked as free advertising: the company embraced the joke rather than fighting it.

faq.q: What song is in the Jet2 holiday meme?
faq.a: "Hold My Hand" by Jess Glynne, released in 2015, which Jet2 uses in its ads.

faq.q: Who is the voice in the Jet2 holiday ad?
faq.a: British actress Zoë Lister, known for her role as Zoe Carpenter in Hollyoaks.

faq.q: Why is the Jet2 holiday meme funny?
faq.a: It pairs a sunny promise of a perfect holiday with clips where everything goes wrong, so the contrast does the joke.
